svg.title: Bakuhatsu — Doctrine of Detonation. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Explosion classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Primed Fuse forks into Shaped Charge then Ground Zero, or Powder Keg then Critical Mass. Smoke and Shrapnel forks into Hardened Casing then Siege Battery, or Slow Burn then Chain Reaction. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Explosion jutsu.

Primed Fuse answers \"How do I make my detonations land harder: charge myself or aim the charge?\" with Critical Mass (both compounding self buffs 43%) and Ground Zero. Smoke and Shrapnel answers \"How do I win what the blast leaves behind: shelter in the smoke or leave the shrapnel burning?\" with Siege Battery (Blast Shield 45%) and Chain Reaction (Afterburn 45%). The kit has no heal, lifesteal, reflect or Decrease Damage Given rows, so no sustain or suppression route is invented."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Primed Fuse","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":2,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"},{"tag":"increasedamagetaken","flat":2,"display_role":"ENEMY DEBUFF"}],"flavor":"Every detonation begins as a held breath and a lit fuse.","coverage_note":"Charge 4 Explosion and Howitzer Crash self buffs 35 \u2192 37%; This pass restores it as the director pattern: Shaped Charge is now a +3% Increase Damage Taken setup (was +2 Damage) and Ground Zero a +2 Damage payoff (was +3), so the only Damage total is +2 (pre-batch +5: Nova 55, the 40 rows 45). The pre-batch wiring returns with it: Smoke and Shrapnel (+2% Decrease Damage Taken, +2% Afterburn; the first pass's Eye of the Blast) roots the fortress and the mark, and Slow Burn returns under it at +3% Afterburn (first pass +5%). Kept from the first pass: Powder Keg +2% and Critical Mass +4% Increase Damage Given (pre-batch +3% and +5%). Chain Reaction keeps its +5% Afterburn and drops its pre-batch +3% Increase Damage Taken (final review): on the same Charge 4 Explosion cast as the burn it took the mark to exposure 40% / Afterburn 45% with Primed Fuse (\u2248 \u00d72.03), and it raised the same exposure row as Shaped Charge's setup. Unchanged: Primed Fuse, Hardened Casing, Siege Battery.","Increase Damage Given is held at +8%, not +10%: its two self buffs compound when both are live, so +8% takes the double-buff window from \u00d71.82 to \u00d72.04; +10% would reach \u00d72.10. Exposure is one row, +5% at most (Primed Fuse plus Shaped Charge, the only Hidden or Advanced Art that raises it). Maxima over every legal allocation: Increase Damage Given +8%, Increase Damage Taken +5%, Afterburn +10%, Decrease Damage Taken +10%, Damage +2.","Filters (\u00a73): both Increase Damage Given rows list the Highest stat and no element, so they match every element-less hit of any stat type and the caster's highest-stat elemental hits, all three Explosion attacks included. The exposure lists Earth, Explosion, Lightning and None; Afterburn and Blast Shield's row list all four stat types and no element. The bloodline Increase Damage Given passive (25% + 0.15 per level; Lightning, Earth, Explosion, None) multiplies last; the Earth-only 15% Decrease Damage Taken passive is separate from Blast Shield's row.","Delivery (\u00a73b, \u00a74b): every jutsu has cooldown 7. The three Damage casts cost 60 AP (Inferno Cataclysm spiral around the caster, Kinetic Nova circle on a target, Howitzer Crash circle on empty ground that moves the caster) and are ENEMIES-only. Charge 4 Explosion (40 AP, single target, range 4) carries the self buff, the exposure and the Afterburn; Howitzer Crash carries the second self buff; Blast Shield (40 AP) the reduction. SELF rows land on the caster at cast. Every buff and debuff is live only in the two rounds after its cast, so neither self buff raises its own jutsu's hit.","Fourth purchases: Ground Zero takes Powder Keg (self buffs 39%) or Smoke and Shrapnel; Critical Mass takes Shaped Charge (exposure 40%) or Smoke and Shrapnel; Chain Reaction takes Primed Fuse (self buffs 37%, exposure 37%: an ally's hit on the mark \u00d71.37 \u00d7 1.45 \u2248 \u00d71.99) or Hardened Casing; Siege Battery takes Primed Fuse (self buffs 39%) or Slow Burn (Afterburn 40%). Shaped Charge cannot join Chain Reaction (5 BP), so no build stacks the setup onto the mark. The two all-offense Primed Fuse builds share three nodes and differ in the capstone: in the double-buff window a Nova on the exposed target comes to 50 \u00d7 2.86 \u2248 143 with Critical Mass and 52 \u00d7 2.70 \u2248 141 with Ground Zero, so Critical Mass wins whenever the charge round is paid (and on weapons, basic attacks and off-kit hits), Ground Zero whenever it is not (52 against 50, 42 against 40). No fourth makes a route automatic."],"risks":["Damage tier: Ground Zero lifts Kinetic Nova 50 \u2192 52, past the 50 Nuke tier (above_nuke_rationale; director precedent RUL-2026-10-04-001/-002). Inferno Cataclysm and Howitzer Crash 40 \u2192 42 stay Normal.","Classification: Explosion is shared with Bakuhatsu Suru Nendo (expected under RUL-2026-10-03-005). The three Damage rows and the exposure row carry Explosion; both self buffs, the Afterburn row and Blast Shield's row need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver, and Blast Shield (no Explosion row) also needs an authored classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit Explosion coverage is unverified.","Reach: the self buffs multiply every matching caster hit in their window, on every target an area attack catches, plus weapons, basic attacks and off-kit jutsu; the exposure and Afterburn raise allies' hits on the mark. Blast Shield's reduction is caster-only.","Charge 4 Explosion concentration: one 40 AP cast can carry three enhanced rows (Chain Reaction with Primed Fuse: self buff 37%, exposure 37%, Afterburn 45%; Critical Mass with Shaped Charge: self buff 43%, exposure 40%). Afterburn per hit is capped at 60% of the hit, so 45% leaves 15 points for other Afterburn sources.","Friendly fire: the Damage rows are ENEMIES-only, so +2 Damage never reaches allies. Charge 4 Explosion may be aimed at an ally (OTHER_USER); its enhanced exposure and Afterburn then land on the ally while the self buff stays on the caster. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Explosion jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE BAKUHATSU KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Explosion classification / forked tree
